text: No phone for the first 30 minutes after you wake up
Start one conversation you'd normally avoid
Drink a full glass of water before anything else
Move for 15 minutes: walk, lift, push-ups, anything counts
One 25-minute lock-in with your phone in another room
Write down today's one must-do and finish it first
Log every dollar you spent today
Spend 15 minutes practicing a skill you'd want to get paid for
Skip your go-to bad habit once today, on purpose
Do the one thing you've been putting off for a week
